uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4681-5170-6578-8249.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
4681-5170-6578-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sephiroth trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1636-3899-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3899-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1
Repeat.

728-1329-1778-2178.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
728-1329-1778-2178.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2324-2415.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1308-2557-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-2557-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

372-1090-5694.manaNeeded: {6}{C}{C}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-5694.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

3457-5168-7791.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {R}{G}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Bloom Tender.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

215-850-1115.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-1115.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1115-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1115-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1115-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4659-4772-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-4772-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-4460.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1753-2366-3512-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1753-2366-3512-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

328-5220-5256-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-5220-5256-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2173-2448-5220-5931.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-5931.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1477-1562-4375.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

4631-4929-6824.description:
Activate Essence Depleter by paying {1}{C}, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1395-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

280-5451-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-5451-5702-6664.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2043-4050-5446-6753.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.
2043-4050-5446-6753.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

560-2034-2425-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2034-2425-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

3821-4823-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
3821-4823-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake, targeting Timeless Witness
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

2018-5256-6288.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2324-3097-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2146-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

56-2921-5695.notablePrerequisites: Infested Thrinax entered the battlefield this turn
56-2921-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

2907-3510-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
"Saproling" chosen with Conspiracy.
2907-3510-4875.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, creating either a 1/1 Insect creature token or a token copy of Scute Swarm.
When the creature token enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Conspiracy, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates an infinite mandatory loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.

917-1383-1742.notablePrerequisites: You have no cards in hand.
917-1383-1742.description:
Activate Idle Thoughts by paying {2}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

204-776-2450.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least three creatures without summoning sickness.
204-776-2450.description:
Activate three creatures you control by tapping them, adding {2}{U} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Whim of Volrath to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control four or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

259-2334-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
Halo-Charged Skaab and Soulherder's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Halo-Charged Skaab trigger, causing each player to mill two cards and put Time Warp on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

628-2034-2193.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1754-2302-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Guan Yu.
Guan Yu and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Guan Yu, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Guan Yu's power.
Repeat.
